description: Find resolved references to a symbol — who actually calls or imports it. Pass path (and start when several symbols share a name) to disambiguate. Use before renaming or deleting anything.

limit.description: Maximum items to return (default 50, max 500). The response reports totalCount and truncated so you can tell whether you saw everything.

start.description: Declaration start offset, to disambiguate further.

name: find_references
title: Find references
